author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted — Paid Opportunities
content:
HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES

Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027.

If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work.

Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required.

These are paid gigs.
We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor.
We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork.
(Yes, we're aware AI art has appeared on our channel before, and we'd love to return to using human artists full-time once the budget supports it, and this is part of that plan.)

Interested?
Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability:
Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com
Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

Know a talented artist who would be a great fit?
Tag them below or share this post to help us find them!

#ChillingTalesForDarkNights #HorrorArt #HorrorIllustration #ArtistsWanted #PaidArtOpportunities

author: Benjamin Geoffroy Dit Belhumeur
title: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series
content:
Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series

Belhumeur Books is looking for an illustrator for the first book in a new children's picture book series, and we want it to be the start of a long partnership, not a one-off gig. We have steady book work planned well beyond this first title: the right illustrator will have ongoing commissions for the foreseeable future.

The project: ~640 words, 14 full spreads + cover, 8.5" × 8.5" paperback. Warm, playful, family-centered, told entirely in first-person visuals. We're after soft, expressive, cinematic storytelling; classic picture-book charm with real emotional range.

Who we're looking for: An emerging illustrator ready to earn their first picture book credit, or add a strong title to an existing portfolio. You need to draw the same characters, animals, and settings again and again, different scenes, different angles, and keep them recognizable every time. Strong sequential storytelling across full spreads.

Pay: $3,000 flat for book one, in four $750 milestones (signing / approved thumbnails & character designs / approved finished illustrations / print-ready delivery). 

Two shortlisted finalists each get $100 for a paid test. 

Future books come with paid commissions and the opportunity to negotiate ongoing royalty participation. 

Prominent cover and title-page credit.

Timeline: 
Hire by November 1, 2026; 
Thumbnails ~December 15; 
Finished art ~February 1, 2027; 
Print-ready ~March 1, 2027

To apply: Email belhumeur.books@gmail.com with your portfolio link, 3–5 samples showing the same characters across multiple scenes and angles plus sequential pages, a sentence or two about yourself, your availability, and confirmation your work is original and human-made (no generative AI).

author: Minji Art
title: Looking for part-time WEBTOON Artist
content:
Looking for part-time WEBTOON Artist!!

Hello everyone! I don't know if this is allowed to post here, but if it's not, feel free to kindly remove it admin.

I'm MINJI, one of the artists working on an exclusive Manhwa project that's expected to be released next year 2027. Due to the team's busy schedule managing the major production process, we're currently looking to hire an additional team member who could take care of drawing skits for promotional purposes on Social Media. The skits will contain characters interaction from the said project, the format would be simple, "slide-show" type of videos. You'll work closely with the team and references will be given. 

The project is heavily Manhwa style and focusing on action fantasy, with dragons and dungeon elements, so we'll need someone who can replicate that style and vibe, and someone comfortable drawing creatures, humanoid or not. Reference: Solo Leveling

YOUR TASK:

-Approximately 200 panels ready to be turned into a skit.

-Gives timely updates

-The skits will be simpler: Line art, flat color and simple shading + White background

-Turnaround Time: 3-7 Days but negotiable

REQUIREMENTS:

-Uses Clip Studio Paint Pro/Ex

-Uses Photoshop (optional)

If interested to apply, please comment down your portfolio, rates per panel (USD) and turnaround time. We'll mainly prioritize candidates with Manhwa art style. Thank you! 

UPDATE AND KINDLY REMINDER

Please kindly refrain from sending me DMs, I won't be able to accommodate every one! Just comment down your portfolio.

One thing I'd like to add: The team leader/creator of the project will be checking out your portfolio and will decide who to hire.

Thank you everyone for taking interest!
